verdict.rationale: Claude is a general-purpose AI assistant and model platform for chat, coding, and API use, not equity-management or cap-table software. Issuing options through a board approval flow with a 409A-compliant strike price is outside its product category, and nothing in the evidence shows Claude ships such a workflow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can issue options to a new hire with a board approval flow and a 409A-compliant strike price in one end-to-end workflow
